answer_1.quote: We conduct experiments on model scales ranging from 3B to 70B. The efficiency and effectiveness of MoDification are verified on such a wide array of scales. With acceptable performance decline, MoDification can achieve up to ∼1.2× speedup in latency and ∼1.8× reduction in memory compared to original LLMs especially in long-context applications.
